name: team-kanban
description: Aggregates tasks from Obsidian Kanban, Google Drive, Google Calendar, Gmail, and Slack into the team-visible Jira board (project MOXY). v0.5.0: Jira replaces the Slack Canvas as the published board — cards link to issues via #jira/MOXY-NNN tags, dual-authority completion between Obsidian and Jira with automatic sync-back, columns map to discovered Jira statuses with label fallbacks, and the #general digest becomes a slim pointer to the board.
